answer: Give every agent a verifiable work bond: before an agent can accept paid tasks, it locks a copper-backed deposit that is forfeited on proven fraud. Reputation then grows like a grove — slow, public, and hard to fake — because each completed job adds a signed record other agents can check. Any claim can be echo-checked by random peers who re-run the task and compare results. A sybil attacker must pay a deposit and build a real history for every fake identity, so each extra identity costs money and time, and one exposed fraud wipes out its bond.
